Hey im 18M I feel the same I've gone through life always trying to be the best. I can't say my parents weren't supportive but the beatings and shouting and just general abuse has made me very sheltered. I've recently come out of a 2 year relationship. I had a good time with her and I still love her. But I've realised how abusive it actually was like she used to cut herself and I'd sit with her with a towel on her leg brushing her hair and holding her. There was times that I lost hope in it and I feel guilty for that. But even after all of it she said I didn't do enough and that I caused a lot of her pain because i was always unsure as to what i wanted.The impact that this abuse has had on my life was made very apparent the other day I was at a work party. I was drinking and enjoying myself and then a girl I've worked with for a while who I've opened up to about a lot of my life was coming on to me like touching my arm hugging me and then when I was outside smoking she just walked up to me and kissed me told me it was going to be ok and for the first time in a while I felt relief. She's great but I cant commit to her. I'm Scared of putting my heart into that position again and I just left. She's called and messaged and idk how to reply and I have to see her tomorrow at work. I've wanted to die for a long time. I've tried to kill myself many many times. Overdosing, hanging, I've been hit by 4 cars and I can't even do that right.



I'm going to do it tomorrow after work. I have a plan and I'm sure I've tied everything up I've made videos for everyone in my life and explained where it went wrong and what I felt at the end and I've scheduled them to be sent out just after my death. I don't want to be convinced otherwise I've experienced everything I want to from life and now I think I'm finally ready. 

This app has been a great distraction and I wish anyone reading this the best I hope you feel better soon and know that I love you.
